column3: BSB renders “let us fear” as “let us be careful” and adds “of it.”
BSB follows the critical text: the hearers “did not share the faith” of others (μὴ συγκεκερασμένους); in the Textus Receptus it is the word that was not mixed with faith.
BSB adds “As for the others” and “His”; “since” renders “from.”
BSB adds “as He says in the passage above.”
BSB divides the verse into three sentences.
BSB renders “before Him” as “from God’s sight.”
BSB renders “the confession” as “what we profess.”
BSB adds “we have one who” and “that we are.”
